description: Source code for Windows-specific UDP socket implementation in Chromium, including asynchronous IO handling, socket options, and QoS management.

classes.name: UDPSocketWin::Core
classes.description: Encapsulates state for asynchronous network IO operations, including overlapped IO and event watchers.

classes.name: QwaveApi
classes.description: Provides access to Windows QoS API functions for managing socket flows and DSCP settings.

classes.name: DscpManager
classes.description: Manages DSCP and QoS flow for a socket, including handle creation and address-specific configuration.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Core::WatchForRead
methods.description: Starts watching for read completion events.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Core::WatchForWrite
methods.description: Starts watching for write completion events.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Core::ReadDelegate::OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Callback invoked when read event is signaled, triggers completion handling.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Core::WriteDelegate::OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Callback invoked when write event is signaled, triggers completion handling.

methods.name: QwaveApi::AddSocketToFlow
methods.description: Adds a socket to a QoS flow.

methods.name: QwaveApi::RemoveSocketFromFlow
methods.description: Removes a socket from a QoS flow.

methods.name: DscpManager::Set
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for the socket, managing QoS flows accordingly.

methods.name: DscpManager::PrepareForSend
methods.description: Prepares QoS flow for sending data to a specific remote address.
